structures.description: Open with a startling question, give the intuitive wrong answer, then build to the real answer with escalating reveals.
Take the viewer on a journey (outward, inward, forward in time), each stop a new reveal.
Tell a true story with a human problem at its core and a clear climax that reveals the idea.

Escalating sequence of 4-5 examples, each more surprising than the last, biggest saved for the end. Each example must advance ONE running idea (state it in the first 20 seconds and pay it off at the end) and get a specific number and a reveal — never a catalogue of similar cases, never more than 5 items.
State a surprising principle up front, then prove it with two or three concrete cases.
